islr.title: An Introduction to Statistical Learning
islr.authors: Gareth James, Daniela Witten, Trevor Hastie and Robert Tibshirani
islr.note: A standard first text on statistical learning; the course folder has no textbook.

basics-of-machine-learning.why: What statistical learning is and where it is used.

data-for-machine-learning.why: Example data sets and notation for inputs and outputs.

learning-categories.why: Supervised and unsupervised learning, regression and classification.

statistical-learning-vs-machine-learning.why: Prediction versus inference and the accuracy-interpretability trade-off.

linear-regression-and-its-output.why: Least squares, R², the F-statistic and coefficient p-values.
